title: Viral Forensics + Niche Style Banks
summary: YTIntel now has a dedicated workflow for the core product promise: paste a video that is blowing up, inspect the public replay peaks and script mechanics, bank the style evidence by niche, compare repeated winner language and turn the accumulated evidence into a new script brief instead of starting from a blank page.
discord_changes: Added Viral Forensics: paste one breakout video and see the exact public Most Replayed timestamps beside the nearby transcript, plus hook, re-hooks, script engine, WPM, payoff timing and available visual/audio evidence.

Added Niche Style Banks that compound winner DNA across saved videos and surface dominant hook/format, pacing, re-hook cadence, replay position, recurring short phrases, visual drivers and attributed audio.
Added evidence-backed Script Starter briefs and direct Pattern Mine attachment so a 5-10 video winner/control study can feed the same niche bank used to plan the next video.
changes: Added a new Viral Lab tab as a first-class workflow rather than forcing creators to jump between Analyse, Visuals, History and Pattern Mine.
Viral Lab shows channel-relative outlier evidence when available and explicitly labels the baseline as unverified when it is not.

Added a Rewind Map using the public Most Replayed curve: up to eight replay/seek-interest peaks with exact timestamps, nearby transcript excerpts and the nearest evidence-backed hotzone driver where available.
Added a Hook + Re-hook DNA view using the measured hook type, short opening excerpt, re-hook timestamps, re-hook reasons, payoff timing and cadence evidence already extracted by YTIntel.
Added a Script Engine view for format engine, WPM, sentence style, proof/test loops per minute, payoff/reveal cadence and transferable mechanics.
Added a Visual + Audio DNA handoff that reuses the real storyboard sampling and public caption/audio evidence rather than inventing editing metrics that cannot be measured from the public sources.
Added Niche Style Banks with local persistence and optional authenticated cloud sync through a new per-user RLS-protected Supabase table.

Style Banks keep compact evidence from each saved video: channel-relative outlier, hook, re-hooks, WPM, payoff timing, format engine, replay peaks, recurring terms, visual drivers, audio cues and attributed tracks.

Style Bank winner aggregates use verified >=1.5x channel-relative breakouts once at least two verified winners exist; before that the bank stays explicitly in LEARNING mode instead of pretending the sample is proven.

Added cross-video short-phrase mining across saved hook, re-hook and replay excerpts. A phrase only surfaces after appearing in at least two different saved videos and is shown as recurring language evidence, not copy to paste.

Added an evidence-backed Script Starter. Creators can enter their next idea and get a production brief using the bank's observed hook style, format engine, WPM, first-payoff timing, re-hook cadence, replay-position tendency, visual/audio evidence and repeated language themes.
Added five starting-angle prompts from the active Style Bank so idea creation begins from observed niche mechanics rather than a generic blank AI prompt.
Wrapped Pattern Mine so a 5-10 near-identical winner/control study can attach directly to the active Style Bank with repeated points, short source excerpts and the winner-vs-pack evidence preserved.
Added a direct Open Viral Forensics action to completed video analyses, a dedicated PWA shortcut for Viral Lab and a deep-link router so installed-app shortcuts can open the new workflow reliably.

Added a server-side entitlement foundation with early_access, discord, creator, pro and founder tiers. It is intentionally not a fake paywall: Stripe billing and Discord membership verification are not activated until real provider connections are supplied.
Updated PWA cache and installed-app metadata for v0.27.

Preserved the evidence guardrails: Most Replayed is public replay/seek interest rather than private retention, outlier multiples are observations rather than forecasts, and the product tells creators to borrow mechanics and cadence rather than copy distinctive wording or scenes.
why_it_matters: This moves YTIntel much closer to the intended paid product: not another generic idea generator, but a creator research system that can explain why a niche winner is unusual, show where public viewers replayed it, remember how winning scripts in that niche are structured and turn that accumulated evidence into the next production brief.
